title: Temporally Centered SIGReg Improves LeWorldModel Representations for Robot Policy Learning
abstract: arXiv:2607.26924v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent work on LeWorldModel (LeWM) has shown that the Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularizer (SIGReg) enables stable end-to-end world model learning from pixels by regularizing the latent representation toward an isotropic Gaussian. While effective for latent-space planning, the representations learned by Raw LeWM are poorly suited for downstream robot policy learning. In this paper, through Monte Carlo analysis, we show that the Raw LeWM objective biases variance allocation toward the temporally persistent component, thereby suppressing the variance of the temporally centered residual. Consistent with this analysis, trained Raw LeWM representations exhibit suppressed residual variation and reduced decodability of robot state and dynamics, particularly gripper dynamics, which are crucial for robotic manipulation. To address this issue, we apply SIGReg to temporally centered residuals rather than to the whole latent representation. T

translated_title: 时间中心化SIGReg改进LeWorldModel表示以促进机器人策略学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.26924v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：近期关于LeWorldModel（LeWM）的研究表明，草绘各向同性高斯正则化器（SIGReg）通过将潜在表示正则化为各向同性高斯分布，能够实现从像素到端到端世界模型的稳定学习。尽管该方法在潜在空间规划中有效，但原始LeWM学习到的表示对下游机器人策略学习适应性较差。本文通过蒙特卡洛分析，揭示了原始LeWM目标将方差分配偏向于时间持久成分，从而抑制了时间中心化残差的方差。与这一分析一致，训练后的原始LeWM表示表现出残差变化被抑制，以及机器人状态和动力学（尤其是对机器人操作至关重要的夹爪动力学）的可解码性降低。为解决此问题，我们将SIGReg应用于时间中心化残差而非整个潜在表示。
tldr: 本文发现原始LeWM模型因方差偏向时间持久成分而抑制残差变化，损害机器人策略学习，因此提出将SIGReg应用于时间中心化残差以改善表示可解码性。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies that the raw LeWM objective biases variance toward temporally persistent components, suppressing residual variation and harming robot policy learning, and proposes applying SIGReg to temporally centered residuals to improve representation decodability.
